description: EDIT ONLY — modifies a post in-place. NEVER call for reading; use post_posts to create. Published edits go live immediately. Always pass base_updated_at (from get_post.updated_at); without it a concurrent edit is silently overwritten. Custom styled HTML needs a richembed fenced block; bare block HTML is escaped. Do NOT include the title in the content body. Response has links.review_url for drafts — give that link to the user.

agent.description: Your name, on every write: Duet/<channel name> or Grok Bot/<bot name>.

base_updated_at.description: ISO from preceding get_post.updated_at. Server returns 409 CONFLICT with current_updated_at + current_content if post was edited since read; re-read, merge, retry.

content.description: New post body in Markdown. Replaces the whole body. Do not include the title.

description.description: The post's PUBLIC meta description shown in search results and link previews. Overwrites any stored value immediately. THIS IS NOT an edit-comment or reason-for-change field — omit this key entirely unless you explicitly intend to replace the current description.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

featured.description: Mark or unmark the post as featured.

featured_image.description: URL of the post's hero image.

hero_prompt_edited.description: Custom prompt that will be used on the next hero image generation for this post.

id.description: Post UUID or slug to edit.

seo_description.description: New meta description for search results and link previews.

seo_title.description: New title for search results and link previews.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

status.description: New status, e.g. "draft" or "published". Setting a scheduled post back to "draft" unschedules it.

subtitle.description: New subtitle shown beneath the title.

x_discussion_url.description: X post permalink for the post's "Discuss on X" block. null removes it.

name: patch_posts_by_id
title: Patch Posts by ID
